note: Public TRON full-node HTTP APIs plus TronGrid, verified with POST /wallet/getblockbynum for block zero, /wallet/getblock, /wallet/getaccount, /wallet/triggerconstantcontract, and the transaction lookups. These serve the TRON HTTP API under /wallet and /walletsolidity, not Ethereum JSON-RPC. The /wallet routes go to the full nodes and reach TronGrid only when they fail or TronGrid is pinned. The /v1 history routes go to TronGrid, whose free tier answers without a key; a user-supplied TronGrid key raises the rate limit. Tatum's gateway, which refuses keyless use beyond about one request every few seconds, TronStack, which announced its shutdown for the end of 2026, and Pocket Network's gateway, which sometimes routes a constant call to a node that refuses it, are omitted.

endpoints.note: TronGrid, serves history and stands in when the full nodes fail
